meta.name: image-to-code
meta.description: Elite website image-to-code skill for Codex. For visually important web tasks, it must first generate the design image(s) itself, deeply analyze them, then implement the website to match them as closely as possible. In Codex, it must prefer large, readable, section-specific images instead of tiny compressed boards, generate fresh standalone images for sections or detail views instead of cropping old ones, avoid lazy under-generation, avoid cards-inside-cards-inside-cards UI, and keep the hero clean, spacious, readable, and visible on a small laptop.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将设计图转化为精确的网站代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从设计图生成高质量网页代码
copy.tagline_en: Convert design images into precise website code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to generate high-quality website code from design images

howto.what: 做视觉为主的网页时,它会先自己生成网站设计图,再逐张分析文字、排版、间距、颜色、按钮等细节,最后写前端代码尽量还原设计图。分区块各出一张大图,不把多个区块压进一张小图。
howto.when: 当你要求做以视觉为主的网页,比如 hero 区、落地页、重设计等,它会先出图再写代码;修 bug 或纯技术任务不走这个流程。

say.text: 帮我做一个高端落地页,先出设计图再写代码
say.note: 会按区块生成参考图并逐张分析

say.text: 给首页 hero 区单独生成一张大图,文字要清晰可读
say.note: 单独出图,不从旧图裁剪

say.text: 重新生成定价区那张图,配色和字体风格保持不变
say.note: 同一设计语言的更清晰重制

howto.what_en: For visual web tasks it first generates its own design images, analyzes text, typography, spacing, colors and buttons in detail, then writes frontend code to match them. It makes one large image per section, not one compressed board.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for visually important web work such as a hero section, landing page or redesign; images come before code. Bug fixes or mostly technical tasks skip this flow.

say_en.text: Build a premium landing page — design images first, then code
say_en.note: Generates and analyzes per-section reference images

say_en.text: Generate one large, readable image just for the hero section
say_en.note: Fresh image, not cropped from an old one

say_en.text: Regenerate the pricing image but keep colors and type the same
say_en.note: Cleaner render of the same design system
